title: Launcher fingerprint's index-diff hash depends on the worktree's checked-out line endings, so a scratch worktree cannot reproduce it
outcome: The launcher's trackedIndexDiffSha256 (scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs: `git diff --cached HEAD --binary`) identifies the staged content independently of how the worktree's files are checked out, so the integration owner can reproduce a gate's recorded input from the commit alone (for example, in a no-checkout scratch worktree).
acceptance: The launcher fingerprint's staged-content field identifies the staged blobs independently of the worktree's checked-out line endings, so the same index gives the same value in a CRLF checkout, an LF checkout and a no-checkout worktree; the change is recorded in docs/test.md, including that older fingerprints are not comparable.

A fail-first test in scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.test.mjs builds the same index in two checkouts with different line-ending conversion and shows the field is equal, while a real content change to a staged file changes it.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Implemented checkout-independent staged-index fingerprinting, documented the new format, and added the LF/CRLF/no-checkout regression. Exact-input full gate passed all five stages; independent review pair found no Medium+ issues; fresh acceptance evaluation bd290d2963cc4a8e9dcda9284c1faf91 passed 3/3. Commit 8b70610e564bbce39149b75bda9eefd371e89eda (tree fcd26ff) is on origin/master, fast-forward verified by the integration owner. Installation is deferred by the coordinator.
